arguments.sql:
WITH delivered_orders AS (
    SELECT order_id, customer_id
    FROM main.olist_orders
    WHERE order_status = 'delivered'
),
five_star_reviews AS (
    SELECT order_id, review_id
    FROM main.olist_order_reviews
    WHERE review_score = 5
)
SELECT
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM delivered_orders) AS delivered_order_rows,
    (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) FROM delivered_orders) AS delivered_order_ids,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM main.olist_customers) AS customer_rows,
    (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id) FROM main.olist_customers) AS customer_ids,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM main.olist_order_items AS i JOIN delivered_orders AS o ON o.order_id = i.order_id) AS delivered_item_rows,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM main.olist_order_items AS i JOIN delivered_orders AS o ON o.order_id = i.order_id LEFT JOIN main.olist_customers AS c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id) AS delivered_items_after_customer_join,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM five_star_reviews) AS five_star_review_rows,
    (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT review_id) FROM five_star_reviews) AS five_star_review_ids,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT DISTINCT order_id, review_id FROM five_star_reviews)) AS five_star_order_review_pairs,
    (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) FROM five_star_reviews) AS five_star_order_ids,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM main.olist_order_items WHERE price IS NULL OR freight_value IS NULL) AS missing_price_or_freight_rows

WITH delivered_seller_orders AS (
    SELECT i.seller_id,
           o.order_id,
           o.customer_id,
           SUM(i.price - i.freight_value) AS order_profit
    FROM main.olist_orders AS o
    JOIN main.olist_order_items AS i ON i.order_id = o.order_id
    WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered'
    GROUP BY i.seller_id, o.order_id, o.customer_id
),
five_star_reviews_by_order AS (
    SELECT order_id, COUNT(*) AS review_count
    FROM main.olist_order_reviews
    WHERE review_score = 5
    GROUP BY order_id
),
seller_totals AS (
    SELECT d.seller_id,
           COUNT(DISTINCT c.customer_unique_id) AS distinct_customers,
           SUM(d.order_profit) AS total_profit,
           COUNT(DISTINCT d.order_id) AS distinct_orders,
           SUM(COALESCE(r.review_count, 0)) AS five_star_ratings
    FROM delivered_seller_orders AS d
    LEFT JOIN main.olist_customers AS c ON c.customer_id = d.customer_id
    LEFT JOIN five_star_reviews_by_order AS r ON r.order_id = d.order_id
    GROUP BY d.seller_id
),
achievements AS (
    SELECT 1 AS category, 'Most distinct customer unique IDs' AS achievement,
           seller_id, distinct_customers AS value
    FROM seller_totals
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 2, 'Highest profit', seller_id, total_profit
    FROM seller_totals
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 3, 'Most distinct orders', seller_id, distinct_orders
    FROM seller_totals
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 4, 'Most 5-star ratings', seller_id, five_star_ratings
    FROM seller_totals
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT category, achievement, seller_id, value,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
               PARTITION BY category ORDER BY value DESC, seller_id
           ) AS seller_rank
    FROM achievements
)
SELECT achievement, seller_id, value
FROM ranked
WHERE seller_rank = 1
ORDER BY category
LIMIT 4
